focus: Hadamard 668 via cellular automata only if locality is made honest by the representation: promote composite-packet and lag-residue bridges, retire the current single-packet H1 branch as an active frontier method, and keep schedule-only or generative-rule ideas out of the immediate queue.

promoted_bridges.bridge: Anti-splash composite-packet library plus defect-packet influence-graph CA
promoted_bridges.reason: This is the most direct response to the validated actuator-basis failure in H1 while staying anchored to the canonical 64-modular frontier seed.

promoted_bridges.bridge: Lag-residue CA on four 167-channels with explicit family-leakage audit
promoted_bridges.reason: The feedback says the lag field is the natural local object, and H2 is now justified by principled locality failure rather than by tuning frustration.

promoted_bridges.bridge: Warning-propagation side fields feeding lag-space or influence-graph CA
promoted_bridges.reason: Message-passing fields are the strongest adjacent signal for the autocorrelation landscape, but should remain side information rather than replace CA actuation.

retired_bridges.bridge: Current single-packet defect-syndrome CA on the q/s packet lattice
retired_bridges.reason: Retired after the first matched frontier kill test: no seed improvement, support diffusion on every restart, and a validated fake-local packet basis.

retired_bridges.bridge: Generative spacetime row-emission CA rule search
retired_bridges.reason: Still too weakly anchored to the frontier and too exposed to direct CA-construction overlap to justify immediate budget.

next_experiments.name: Composite packet scan
next_experiments.goal: Enumerate symmetry-safe composite packets and measure exact delta-splash statistics on the canonical seed and one solved control.

next_experiments.name: Influence-graph CA prototype
next_experiments.goal: Build a sparse defect-packet bipartite graph from retained low-splash composites and compare CA against matched non-CA baselines on that graph.

next_experiments.name: H2 lag-space pilot
next_experiments.goal: Implement one lag-residue representation with exact delta tables, one lag-space non-CA control, and an explicit family-leakage audit.

next_experiments.name: Warning-propagation ablation
next_experiments.goal: Add lag-field side channels to the retained CA representation and compare plain CA, plain warning propagation, and the hybrid under identical accounting.
